name: 17TRACK
description: 17TRACK provides a multi-carrier package tracking API that aggregates shipment status across hundreds of global postal and express carriers. Developers register numbers, receive tracking events, and get delivery updates for international e-commerce and logistics workflows.

auth.details: API key via 17token header (self-serve signup on api.17track.net)

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan with limited monthly quota (confirm on dashboard/pricing)
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans by tracking volume; see official pricing

use_cases: track a parcel by tracking number across carriers
register tracking numbers for push or poll updates
get multi-carrier delivery status for e-commerce orders
detect carrier from a tracking number
batch-check shipment status for fulfillment dashboards
